_about: Routes that appear in SCHOLARSHIP_PATHWAYS_MASTER.md (GitHub site) but not on the Pathway Board artifact. Same schema as board.json paths.

paths.name: Maastricht MSc Global Health + NL High Potential Scholarship
paths.cost: €1,550/month; €100 UM handling fee (not covered by UM)
paths.dt: Complete programme file before 10 Dec 2026; scholarship closes 1 Feb 2027, 23:59 CET
paths.note: Gates: GPA at least 7.5/10 (75%); age 35 or under on 1 Sep 2027; about 2% of applicants awarded. Open question: whether UM puts an MBBS on the bachelor's route (GRE General needed) or the bachelor's + master's route (no GRE). Ask UM admissions.

paths.name: Maastricht MSc Epidemiology + NL High Potential Scholarship
paths.cost: €1,550/month; €100 UM handling fee (not covered by UM)
paths.dt: Complete programme file before 10 Dec 2026; scholarship closes 1 Feb 2027
paths.note: Same deadlines, GPA and GRE gates as the Global Health MSc. Caution: the MSc is listed part-time while the scholarship is for full-time programmes; confirm on UM's 2027-28 participating-programmes list that the full-time variant is eligible.

paths.name: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships 2027/28
paths.dt: Opens 10 Nov 2026 · closes 8 Dec 2026, 16:00 GMT
paths.note: Apply to an approved course at the university AND through the CSC portal. Bangladesh eligible. Needs, by September 2027, a first degree of at least upper second-class (2:1) or equivalent — how an MBBS maps to 2:1, and whether the degree is conferred before the internship ends, are open questions. The 2027 approved-course list is published before opening.

paths.name: Johns Hopkins Bloomberg PhD in Epidemiology
paths.dt: 1 Dec 2026 via SOPHAS
paths.note: Strongest verified fully funded US fit. A prior graduate degree is 'not required, but highly recommended'. WES/ECE evaluation required; GRE not required or reviewed. Open question: the one-year work-experience line appears on the ScM page, not the PhD page — email BSPH.EpiAcademic@jh.edu to confirm whether internship counts. Stipend rates beyond June 2027 depend on union negotiations.

paths.name: Emory Rollins PhD in Epidemiology
paths.dt: 1 Dec 2026 — final deadline for PhD applicants
paths.note: Full-tuition scholarship for all admitted PhD students plus stipend. A bachelor's is the stated minimum, so MBBS meets it; GRE optional. Very competitive: 200+ applications for 10–14 places, and admitted students often hold advanced degrees.

paths.name: UNC Gillings PhD in Epidemiology
paths.note: Master's 'beneficial but not required'. Funding is assembled competitively (RA/TA, Graduate School awards). Departmental NIH T32-type training grants usually require US citizenship or permanent residence, so that leg is closed to him. Tuition remission is possible but not guaranteed.

paths.name: Emory Rollins MPH (merit scholarship)
paths.cost: Merit awards 50–100% of tuition; no stipend (programme total $85,356)
paths.dt: 5 Jan 2027 priority deadline (application complete and SOPHAS-verified) — the scholarship gate
paths.note: Internationals are considered automatically if verified by 5 Jan. Every merit award adds REAL $2,500 plus a practicum award of $2,000–4,000. No stipend, so it fails the full-funding filter alone — viable only with US research jobs alongside (the Sakib model). 'Rollins Pathways' scholarship not found on the official page.

paths.name: Columbia Mailman MPH
paths.dt: 1 Dec 2026 preferred; rolling until 15 Jan 2027
paths.note: 'December 1st is the preferred deadline for most master level programs.' The PopFam Future Changemaker Scholarship pays $10,000 only, and Fall 2027 international eligibility isn't stated — not a full-funding plan.

paths.name: Georgia State University MPH
paths.dt: 15 Feb 2027 — priority deadline for scholarships and international applicants
paths.note: A graduate assistantship (tuition waiver + pay) is the funding route; posts are limited and no stipend amount is stated.

paths.name: Johns Hopkins Bloomberg MPH
paths.dt: 1 Dec 2026 (work rule waived for non-US MBBS)
paths.note: The usual two years of full-time health work experience is waived for applicants who finished medical school outside the US (not for MPH/MBA candidates). SOPHAS fee $155; tuition and funding not verified. New maths and science prerequisites apply from the June 2027 intake.

paths.name: The Sakib model: MPH + US research jobs
paths.cost: MPH with up to ~$50k scholarship, living costs from campus jobs
paths.dt: No scheme deadline; each programme sets its own (e.g. Hopkins 1 Dec 2026)
paths.note: A working route, not a scholarship (personal account by Dr. Iftekhar Ahmed Sakib, not an official source). He chose an MPH over a PhD as a shorter US entry, applied via SOPHAS to four MPH programmes, won maximum scholarships worth $50,000 with no stipend, and covers the rest with US jobs such as Clinical Research Coordinator. Method: apply as soon as final professional results are out, WES course-by-course immediately, TOEFL if US-only or IELTS if multi-country, no GRE.

paths.name: DAAD Study Scholarship (Master's)
paths.cost: €992/month + insurance + €460 study allowance + travel allowance; DAAD does not pay tuition
paths.dt: Bangladesh window 1 Jun - 31 Aug 2026 closed (funding from Oct 2027); next call not yet published
paths.note: Germany's realistic funded route for him: no professional-experience requirement is listed (EPOS needs 2+ years). Needs a first degree finished by the start of funding (no more than about 6 years old at the deadline) and admission to a full-time master's at a state-recognised German university.

paths.name: Italy DSU regional scholarship
paths.cost: ≈€7,171+/year grant + full tuition exemption + meals, often housing
paths.dt: 2027/28 regional calls expected around July 2027 (not yet published)
paths.note: Italy's main route. Money comes from the region, based on family income, not grades: family ISEE ≤ €28,339.88 and ISPE ≤ €61,608.48 (2026/27 ceilings). As a Bangladeshi, family income and asset papers are legalised, translated and turned into an 'ISEE parificato' by a CAF office — start collecting them now. Get admitted to an English-taught public-health or epidemiology master's first.

paths.name: Italy MAECI Government Scholarship
paths.cost: Amount not confirmed (9-month grants; check call text)
paths.dt: 2027/28 call not published (2026/27 call closed 26 Mar 2026)
paths.note: Merit-based, via the Study in Italy portal. Some universities add a tuition exemption. Can't be combined with DSU.

paths.name: Invest Your Talent in Italy
paths.dt: 2027/28 call not published (2026/27 edition ran 20 Apr-11 May 2026)
paths.note: Bangladesh is on the eligible-country list. Weak fit: courses concentrate on engineering, technology, design, economics and management — a public-health course was not found. Check the course list when the 2027/28 call opens.

paths.name: University of Padua International Excellence Scholarship
paths.dt: Call One closes 15 Nov 2026; Call Two 1 Dec 2026-1 Mar 2027
paths.note: Highly competitive merit award (up to about 76) for non-Italian citizens with a foreign qualification. An alternative to DSU — you can't hold both.

paths.name: University of Sydney RTP / USYDIS (PhD)
paths.dt: 18 Dec 2026 for Research Periods 3–4, 2027
paths.note: Highest stipend in Australia. No Australian university guarantees MBBS → direct PhD; entry is assessed case by case (qualifications, publications, research capacity), with an MPhil as fallback. Line up a supervisor first.

paths.name: ANU RTP Stipend + International Fee Offset
paths.cost: Stipend + International Fee Offset covering tuition (amounts not stated in verified notes)
paths.dt: Round 2 closes 15 Apr 2027
paths.note: A confirmed supervisor is required.

paths.name: University of Queensland Graduate School Scholarship
paths.dt: No single deadline: four research quarters; scholarship round dates are on UQ's scholarship page (a 19 Oct 2026 close was not confirmed)
paths.note: Supervisor and Expression of Interest come first. 2027 stipend rate not found.

paths.name: Flinders University AGRTPS / FIPRS
paths.dt: This year's round closed June 2026; next round not found
paths.note: Publication-driven: Flinders says applicants who have not published are unlikely to be competitive (up to 5 publications, none older than 5 years, count).

paths.name: University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship
paths.dt: Rounds 1 Feb / 1 May / 1 Aug / 1 Nov — next 1 Feb 2027
paths.note: No separate scholarship application. Manaaki (government) is closed to Bangladesh, so university doctoral scholarships are the NZ route. MBBS → direct PhD is unclear at every NZ university.

paths.name: University of Waikato Doctoral Scholarship
paths.dt: 31 Jan 2027 — unconfirmed; page says four rounds a year
paths.note: Requires an Offer of Place.

paths.name: Victoria University of Wellington Doctoral Scholarship
paths.cost: NZ$32,000/year + domestic fees, up to 3 years
paths.dt: Rounds close 1 Mar / 1 Jul / 1 Nov — next 1 Mar 2027

paths.name: University of Otago Doctoral Scholarship
paths.dt: Quarterly rounds; submit by the first day of the round month — next March 2027
paths.note: The programme is under review, per its own page.

paths.name: University of Canterbury Doctoral Scholarship
paths.cost: Stipend and fee terms not stated in verified notes
paths.dt: May round opens 20 Mar, closes 15 May 2027
paths.note: UC PhD admission criteria not found (page error at last check).

paths.name: Massey University Doctoral Scholarship
paths.dt: Round reportedly closed 1 Oct 2026 (third-party listings, not confirmed on massey.ac.nz); next date not found
paths.note: $90,000 plus fees over three years.

paths.name: University of Antwerp MSc Epidemiology (VLIR-UOS)
paths.dt: VLIR-UOS scholarship not open to Bangladesh; 2027-28 scholarship date not found
paths.note: The VLIR-UOS scholarship is limited to nationals and residents of 29 listed countries; Bangladesh is not on the list. The degree itself is open self-funded via the free UAntwerp application.

paths.name: King's College London: Introduction to Aerospace Medicine
paths.dt: No dates scheduled — register interest only
paths.note: Not a scholarship; an exploration option for the aerospace-medicine thread alongside SpaceMed.
